meta.title: Saline County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Saline County's 2026 budget as adopted by the quorum court in Appropriation Ordinance 2025-20 (December 15, 2025). Fund and department amounts are the ordinance's appropriations; the split into categories comes from the 'Request 2026' column of the county's 2026 budget pages and adds up exactly to them. Some funds move money to other county funds (transfers out, $4,182,000.00 in all), so those dollars show up in both funds.
